items.title: UK right-wingers distance themselves from Trump: Putin is not our friend
items.teaser: Following Donald Trump's Truth Social post featuring a photo of Vladimir Putin captioned "my friend" after the APEC summit in China, Reform UK's Richard Tice reacts with "horror" and Tory deputy leader Alex Burghart says he is "sad and depressed".

items.title: One killed, three injured in Russian attack on store in Kyiv region
items.teaser: One person was killed and three others injured in an enemy attack in the town of Vyshneve, Bucha district, Kyiv region.

items.title: Ukrainian forces down jet-powered drone with a Kalashnikov rifle – video
items.teaser: A mobile fire group from the 81st Separate Slobozhanske Airmobile Brigade downed an unidentified Russian jet-powered UAV using a 5.45mm folding-stock Kalashnikov rifle in Donetsk Oblast, posting video of the intercept.

items.title: Woman injured in Russian drone attack on Bila Tserkva district in Kyiv region
items.teaser: A woman was injured in an attack by Russian drones in the Bila Tserkva district of the Kyiv region.

items.title: Death toll from the Russian attack on Dymer has risen to three
items.teaser: Tymur Tkachenko has confirmed a third body was recovered from a partially destroyed five-storey apartment building in Dymer after a Russian drone strike.

items.title: Ukrainian troops share battlefield drone expertise with 4 NATO allies in US-led exercise
items.teaser: The drills focused on small drones, including first-person-view (FPV) models, Ukraine's General Staff said.

items.title: Ukraine and Sweden discuss fast-tracking Gripen fighter jet deliveries
items.teaser: Ukraine’s Defense Minister Yevhenii Khmara discussed ways to accelerate deliveries of Gripen fighter jets and their weapons systems during a meeting with General Michael Claesson, Supreme Commander of the Swedish Armed Forces.

items.title: One killed and three injured in Russian attack on shop in Kyiv Oblast – photo, videos
items.teaser: Tymur Tkachenko has reported that one person was killed and three injured after a Russian strike damaged a Novus store in Vyshneve on 22 November, while a woman was injured in the Bila Tserkva district.

items.title: Russia strikes gas service facility in Dnipropetrovsk region with guided bomb, several injured
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked a gas service facility in the Dnipropetrovsk region with an aerial bomb on Sunday, November 22.

items.title: Ukrainian forces foil Russian assault attempt in Pokrovsk sector
items.teaser: In the Pokrovsk sector, Ukraine’s 4th Operational Brigade Rubizh of the National Guard thwarted an attempt by Russian invaders to launch an assault using armored vehicles and motorcycles.

items.title: Russians strike gas service facility and two petrol stations, injuring people
items.teaser: Naftogaz Group has reported an aerial bomb hit a gas service facility in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast – injuring one worker and causing two people to suffer from concussion – while two Ukrnafta petrol stations were attacked in Zaporizhzhia Oblast.

items.title: Teenager killed by Russian drone explosion in Sumy Oblast
items.teaser: Local officials have reported that 15-year-old Kyrylo Kozburh from the village of Mazivka was killed on 22 November when a Russian FPV unmanned aerial vehicle detonated in Sumy Oblast.

items.title: Ukrainian troops take part in international Drone Crucible exercises
items.teaser: Ukrainian military personnel took part in joint drone exercises alongside troops from the United States, the United Kingdom, Germany and Latvia.

items.title: Odesa has 291 Invincibility Centers in operation
items.teaser: A total of 291 Invincibility Centers are operating in Odesa, and around 1,000 people have used them since this morning.

items.title: Russia tied its Kaliningrad drone scare to Lithuania—Vilnius says the viral fire photos came from Iran
items.teaser: Lithuania's crisis chief says there is no factual confirmation of any explosions in the exclave.

items.title: Russian attacks cause 'serious damage' to Odesa power grid as outages disrupt city
items.teaser: Repair crews are working to restore electricity, but continued Russian attacks and air raid alerts are disrupting their work, Ukraine's state-owned grid operator Ukrenergo said.

items.title: Slovak foreign minister hints Ukrainians were behind the invasion of Czechoslovakia
items.teaser: Speaking after Slovakia-Russia commission talks on 17 November, Slovak Foreign Minister Juraj Blanár has suggested Ukrainians were behind the 1968 invasion of Czechoslovakia, prompting criticism from the opposition that Moscow made the decision.

items.title: UK government minister says "butcher" Putin is no friend of the United Kingdom
items.teaser: UK government minister Hamish Falconer criticises Donald Trump's warm remarks about Vladimir Putin at the APEC summit in China, stressing that Putin is a "butcher" and not a friend of the United Kingdom.

items.title: Strike on Kerch Bridge comparable in significance to hitting strategic target in Moscow – expert
items.teaser: A strike on the Kerch Bridge can be compared in significance to hitting a strategic target in Moscow. It calls into question the capabilities of the Russian military while highlighting the capabilities of Ukraine’s Defense Forces.

items.title: Bonfires of textbooks and a banned language: a former school head recalls what Russia did to Oleshky’s schools
items.teaser: The former head of a school in the occupied Oleshky community recalls losing her building, her curriculum, and her pupils' right to speak their own language.

items.title: Death toll in Russian attack on Dymer rises to two, four injured
items.teaser: The body of another victim has been recovered from the rubble of a residential apartment building in the town of Dymer, Kyiv region, following a Russian attack, bringing the death toll to two and the number of injured to four.

items.title: Russian attacks cause power outages in five Ukrainian oblasts
items.teaser: As of the morning of 22 November, consumers in Odesa, Dnipropetrovsk, Zhytomyr, Rivne and Kharkiv oblasts remain without electricity after Russian strikes damaged energy facilities, forcing Odesa schools to switch to remote learning.

items.title: Hegseth restricts US-Canada defense cooperation in secret memo – WP
items.teaser: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has introduced new restrictions on cooperation between the US and Canadian militaries.

items.title: Russland setzt binnen einer Woche rund 2.700 Drohnen, fast 1.460 Fliegerbomben und 164 Raketen und gegen Ukraine ein – Selenskyj
items.teaser: Allein innerhalb einer Woche hat Russland rund 2.700 Drohnen, fast 1.460 Fliegerbomben und 164 Raketen gegen die Ukraine eingesetzt.

items.title: IEEPA at 50: Call for Papers
items.teaser: This is from Georgetown's Institute of International Economic Law: Over the last half century, the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA) has become one of the most consequential grants of presidential power in U.S. foreign affairs. When President Jimmy Carter signed IEEPA into law on December
items.source: Int. Economic Law and Policy Blog

items.title: Two bodies recovered from under rubble of apartment block in Kyiv Oblast
items.teaser: Rescue workers have recovered two bodies of people killed in the Russian attack on a five-storey apartment block in Dymer. Four people have been injured.

items.title: Russian drone hits apartment building in Dnipro, destroying one apartment, damaging around 20 others
items.teaser: A Russian drone attacked a ten-story residential building in Dnipro, destroying one apartment and damaging around 20 others.

items.title: Chernivtsi soldier and Plast scout leader Ihor Hanhala dies from frontline wounds – photo
items.teaser: Ihor Hanhala, a 34-year-old soldier from Chernivtsi and mentor with the Ukrainian scouting organisation Plast, has died from wounds sustained on the front line. He co-organised the student Euromaidan protests in his home city and dozens of Plast camps.

items.title: Russia targeted bridges across the Dnipro for weeks—now Ukraine keeps hitting Russia’s supply bridges
items.teaser: Within days the targets included the Kerch Bridge's railway, river crossings in occupied Luhansk Oblast, and Russia's highway to Russian-occupied Crimea in Rostov Oblast.

items.title: Russian drone damages 10-storey apartment block in Dnipro – photo
items.teaser: A 10-storey apartment building in the Peremoha residential area of Dnipro has been damaged in a Russian drone attack. One flat has been virtually destroyed, while around 20 others have sustained damage. No one has been injured, according to the city authorities.

items.title: Ukraine's Defence Forces strike eight Russian oil infrastructure facilities in one week
items.teaser: Ukraine's Defence Forces have carried out a series of strikes against Russian oil infrastructure, military logistics facilities, air defence systems, command posts, and support facilities used by the Russian military.

items.title: Ukraine names 15 Russian-occupied towns and villages for Oleshky-style evacuations, Hola Prystan and Vasylivka among them—the US now holds the list
items.teaser: Kyiv weighed how many people it could bring out and says the list across Kherson and Zaporizhzhia oblasts will be updated, while Moscow, which agreed to the Oleshky truce, has not answered yet.

items.title: Nach Drohnenangriff: Löscharbeiten an der "Sparta II" dauern an
items.teaser: Noch immer laufen die Löscharbeiten an dem russischen Frachter in der Ostsee vor Finnland. Was das Schiff geladen hat, ist weiterhin unklar. Es war von einer Drohne getroffen worden - vermutlich aus der Ukraine.

items.title: Russians attack Zaporizhzhia, leaving one killed
items.teaser: A man was killed in a Russian shelling attack on the city of Zaporizhzhia.

items.title: Nach Angriff auf Hochhaus in Dymer: Leiche aus Trümmern geborgen
items.teaser: Aus den Trümmern eines durch eine russische Drohne beschädigten Hochhauses in Dymer (Region Kyjiw) wurde ein Toter geborgen.

items.title: German far-right leader calls for deportation of up to 2.6 million Ukrainians, Syrians and Afghans
items.teaser: AfD co-leader Tino Chrupalla has urged that up to 2.6 million people be repatriated once protection grounds lapse, but experts say mass deportations are legally impossible.

items.title: Drohnenangriff auf Krasnodar: Zentrale der Nationalgarde brennt offenbar
items.teaser: In der Nacht zum 22. November haben Drohnen in der russischen Region Krasnodar die Zentrale der Nationalgarde Russlands getroffen.

items.title: Body of person killed in Russian drone attack recovered from rubble of apartment building in Dymer
items.teaser: The body of a person killed in a Russian drone attack on an apartment building has been recovered from the rubble in the town of Dymer, Kyiv region.

items.title: Fire on Russian cargo ship off Finland remains unextinguished after attack
items.teaser: On Sunday, November 22, the Finnish Border Guard reported that a fire aboard the Russian cargo ship Sparta II, which was attacked by drones in the Baltic Sea the previous day, had continued throughout the night despite efforts to extinguish it.

items.title: Zelensky says US delays on Patriot missiles are 'difficult to understand' as Russia fires 165 missiles in a week
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky again urged Washington to authorize the transfer of Patriot missiles that Ukraine's allies have already paid for.

items.title: Estonia comments on Ukrainian attack on Russian vessel in Baltic Sea
items.teaser: Estonian Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna says the attack on a Russian dry cargo ship in the Gulf of Finland is a consequence of Russia's war against Ukraine.

items.title: Up to 15 people may be trapped under rubble of damaged building in Dymer
items.teaser: Search and rescue operations are ongoing at the site of a strike on a five-story residential building in Dymer, Kyiv region. Up to 15 people may be trapped under the rubble.

items.title: Bis zu 15 Menschen unter Trümmern in Dymer
items.teaser: In Dymer in der Region Kyjiw läuft derzeit eine Such- und Rettungsaktion an der Stelle, an der ein fünfstöckiges Wohnhaus getroffen wurde.

items.title: Attack on Vyshhorod district: Eight people may be trapped under rubble of apartment building
items.teaser: Emergency rescue operations are ongoing at the site of a Russian attack in the Vyshhorod district of Kyiv region. As many as eight people may be trapped under the rubble of a destroyed apartment building.

items.title: Announcement: Call for Expressions of Interest for a new Co-Editor-in-Chief of EJIL
items.teaser: The European Journal of International Law welcomes expressions of interest in fulfilling the role of Co-Editor-in-Chief. The role involves, among others: Reading and deciding on all manuscripts (re)submitted to EJIL; Deciding on the contents of each issue; Writing editorials; Leading a team of 3 associate editors who c

items.title: Russian attacks across Ukraine injure 30 over past day as rescue operation continues near Kyiv after drone strike
items.teaser: Ukraine's Air Force said Russian troops launched 186 attack drones against Ukraine overnight, of which 161 were shot down.

items.title: A smell of burning over Krasnodar as smoke rises near a Russian National Guard base after the drone night
items.teaser: Residents reported a smell of burning, and a Ukrainian monitor pointed to a military compound of Russia's security force.

items.title: Schools in Odesa switch to remote learning due to power supply problems caused by Russian attacks
items.teaser: Classes will be held remotely from 23 to 27 November as Russian strikes leave the city's electricity, heating and water supplies severely disrupted.

items.title: Russia launches approximately 2,700 drones, nearly 1,460 glide bombs, and 165 missiles at Ukraine in one week – Zelensky
items.teaser: Russia launched approximately 2,700 drones, nearly 1,460 guided aerial bombs, and 165 missiles of various types at Ukraine over the past week. A total of 20 Ukrainian regions came under attack.

items.title: Generalstab meldet binnen eines Tages 131 Gefechte an der Front, die Mehrheit davon in Richtung Pokrowsk
items.teaser: Am 21. November kam es zu 131 Gefechten zwischen den ukrainischen Verteidigern und den russischen Angreifern an der Front.

items.title: Russian strikes leave Odesa’s grid unable to deliver the power it needs as a jet drone crosses into Moldova twice
items.teaser: Air raid alerts keep interrupting repairs to the grid serving Odesa as winter nears, while Moldova's Defense Ministry says a jet drone entered its airspace from Ukraine twice.

items.title: War update: 131 clashes on frontline over past day, most attacks in Pokrovsk direction
items.teaser: A total of 131 combat engagements between Ukraine's Defence Forces and Russian invaders were recorded along the frontline on November 21.

items.title: Russian forces shell nine settlements in Kharkiv region over past day
items.teaser: Russian forces shelled nine settlements in the Kharkiv region over the past 24 hours, causing an elderly woman to suffer an acute stress reaction.

items.title: Revista Română de Arbitraj, Volume 20, Issue 2 (2026)
items.teaser: The updates for the second quarter of 2026 begin with the ICC Commission on Arbitration and ADR launching in April 2026 a Task Force on Artificial Intelligence in Dispute Resolution and conducting an anonymous multilingual survey to understand current AI use across the international arbitration community. The survey wi

items.title: Russians attack energy infrastructure in Zhytomyr region four times in one day
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked energy infrastructure facilities in the Zhytomyr region four times over the past 24 hours.

items.title: Zelenskyy: 14 people still unaccounted for after Russian strike on apartment block in Kyiv Oblast – video
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has said 14 people may be trapped under the rubble of a five-storey building in Dymer, Kyiv Oblast, hit by a Russian drone; nine were evacuated.

items.title: Angriff auf Rayon Wyschhorod: Vermutlich acht Menschen unter Trümmern
items.teaser: Im Rayon Wyschhorodskyj in der Region Kyjiw laufen am Ort des russischen Angriffs Rettungs- und Bergungsarbeiten.

items.title: Lithuania denies involvement in attack on Kaliningrad region following Russian allegations
items.teaser: Lithuania’s National Crisis Management Center (NCMC) has commented on reports by Russian media about an alleged drone in the Kaliningrad region that supposedly entered from Lithuanian territory.

items.title: Nova Kakhovka plant sued Putin and Russian billionaires: the court's ruling
items.teaser: The Commercial Court of Odesa Oblast has ordered the Russian Federation to pay UAH 11.54 million (about US$256,400) in lost profits to the Nova Kakhovka Electromechanical Plant Trade and Production Association. The company also sought to recover money from Kremlin leader Vladimir Putin and other Russians.

items.title: Luftabwehr neutralisiert 161 von 186 russischen Drohnen
items.teaser: Die ukrainische Luftabwehr hat 161 von 186 Kampfdrohnen unschädlich gemacht, mit denen Russland seit Abend dem 21. November das Gebiet der Ukraine angegriffen hat.

items.title: Drone attack damages apartment block in Kyiv region, people may be trapped under rubble
items.teaser: A Russian drone attack damaged a five-story residential building in the Vyshhorod district of the Kyiv region, causing a fire.

items.title: Russian National Guard headquarters in Krasnodar possibly caught fire after drone attack – media
items.teaser: Drones likely struck the Main Directorate of the Russian National Guard (Rosgvardiya) in Russia’s Krasnodar Territory overnight on November 22.

items.title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,637,170 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
items.teaser: The number includes 2,310 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

items.title: Russian vessel struck by drone near Finland still on fire
items.teaser: Finnish firefighters continue to fight a blaze on the Russian cargo ship Sparta II in Finnish waters after a drone strike; the crew was evacuated.

items.title: Russian strike on enterprise in Chernihiv region sparks fire
items.teaser: A Russian attack caused a fire at an enterprise in the Novhorod-Siverskyi district of the Chernihiv region.

items.title: Wyschhorod: Zwei Verletzte und beschädigtes Wohnhaus nach Drohnenangriff
items.teaser: Im RayonWyschhorodskyj in der Region Kyjiw wurde nach einem feindlichen Drohnenabgriff ein fünfstöckiges Wohnhaus beschädigt.

items.title: Russian forces attack infrastructure facilities in Dnipropetrovsk region
items.teaser: Russian shelling has damaged infrastructure facilities in the Dnipropetrovsk region.

items.title: Eleven injured in Russian attacks on Donetsk and Kherson oblasts
items.teaser: Russian strikes injured five people in Sloviansk and six in Kherson Oblast on 21 November, damaging an apartment building, six houses, a gas pipeline and cars.

items.title: Air defenses down 161 of 186 Russian drones launched against Ukraine since evening
items.teaser: Ukraine’s air defense forces neutralized 161 of the 186 drones used by Russian forces to attack Ukraine since the evening of November 21.

items.title: Russische Armee verliert 2.310 weitere Soldaten an einem Tag und zwei Luftabwehrsysteme
items.teaser: Die Verluste der russischen Armee (Gefallene und Verwundete) in der Ukraine belaufen sich vom 24. Februar 2022 bis zum 22. November 2026 auf rund 1.637.170 Soldaten, darunter 2.310 weitere Verluste allein im Laufe des letzten Tages.

items.title: Russia’s war casualty toll in Ukraine up by 2,310 over past day
items.teaser: Russia’s total combat losses in its full-scale invasion of Ukraine from February 24, 2022, to November 22, 2026, have reached approximately 1,637,170 personnel, including 2,310 over the past day.

items.title: Russia attacks Ukraine with 186 drones: hits recorded at 18 locations
items.teaser: Ukraine's air defence shot down or jammed 161 out of 186 Russian drones overnight, including 56 jet-powered, but hits were recorded at 18 locations.

items.title: Ukraine preparing to revive Congressional Ukraine caucuses in both Chambers of new US Congress – Chargé d’Affaires
items.teaser: One of the Ukrainian diplomatic service’s top priorities after the new US Congress begins its work on January 3 will be to revive the Ukrainian caucuses in both chambers of the US legislature and arrange bilateral visits between the two countries.

items.title: People may be trapped under rubble of five-storey building destroyed by Russian attack in Kyiv Oblast – photos, video
items.teaser: A Russian strike destroyed a five-storey building in Dymer, Kyiv Oblast, from ground to fourth floor; nine were evacuated, a child is among those injured and seven people may be trapped.

items.title: Nine injured in Russian attacks on Sumy Oblast – police
items.teaser: Russian forces struck 22 settlements in Sumy Oblast over the past day, injuring nine people in drone attacks, police say.

items.title: Dutch and UK Prime Ministers discuss support for Ukraine during meeting in Amsterdam
items.teaser: Dutch Prime Minister Rob Jetten and UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham discussed support for Ukraine during a meeting in Amsterdam.

items.title: Residential building damaged in Russian drone attack in Vyshhorod district, residents evacuated
items.teaser: A five-story apartment building was damaged in a Russian drone attack in the Vyshhorod district of the Kyiv region. Rescuers are evacuating residents.

items.title: UCCA President: New US Congress creates opportunity to boost Ukraine support, but Trump remains key factor
items.teaser: The new composition of the US Congress offers an opportunity to further strengthen American support for Ukraine, but the factor of President Donald Trump must also be taken into account, says Michael Sawkiw Jr., President of the Ukrainian Congress Committee of America (UCCA).

items.title: 14 feared trapped after Russian drone hits apartment building near Kyiv, injuring 2
items.teaser: "People may still be trapped under the rubble," President Volodymyr Zelensky said.

items.title: Ukrainian border guards down new Russian Filin missile for first time in Chernihiv region
items.teaser: A mobile fire team of the 105th Border Guard Detachment has destroyed a Russian Filin small cruise missile in the Chernihiv region.

items.title: Russia loses 2,310 soldiers over past day
items.teaser: Ukraine's General Staff has updated data on Russian losses: Russia lost 2,310 soldiers killed and wounded over the past day.

items.title: Ukraine should frame Crimea’s occupation as colonialism to reach the Global South – Useinov
items.teaser: Ukraine should explain the occupation of Crimea to countries of the Global South by drawing on their own historical experience of colonialism. At international forums, this approach could help representatives of those countries better understand what Ukraine is fighting for and explain its position back home.

items.title: Zelensky names settlements where Ukraine proposes to conduct humanitarian missions
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky has named settlements in the Kherson and Zaporizhzhia regions where Ukraine proposes conducting humanitarian missions following the successful evacuation of civilians from Oleshky.

items.title: Ukrainian drones reportedly strike Russian National Guard facility in Krasnodar
items.teaser: Ahead of the reported attack, a temporary ground stop was imposed at Krasnodar Airport, officials reported, amid the presence of drones in the nearby airspace.

items.title: Light sleet expected in some parts of Ukraine on Sunday, temperatures to range from 0°C to +8°C
items.teaser: Some regions of Ukraine will experience light sleet on Sunday, November 22, while no significant precipitation is expected elsewhere.

items.title: Melania Trump hopes for new ceasefire between Ukraine and Russia by Christmas
items.teaser: US First Lady Melania Trump has expressed hope that a ceasefire between Ukraine and Russia will be reached by Christmas. She said that negotiations with representatives of both countries are underway.

items.title: Umfrage der EU-Kommission zu den Exportkontrollpraktiken bei immateriellen Transfers von Gütern mit doppeltem Verwendungszweck (ITT)
items.teaser: Die EU-Kommission erarbeitet derzeit gemeinsam mit den EU-Mitgliedstaaten praktische Leitlinien zur Anwendung der Verordnung (EU) 2021/821 mit Blick auf die Kontrolle immaterieller Transfers von Dual-Use-Gütern. Die Veröffentlichung ist bis Ende 2026 beabsichtigt.

items.title: Exportkontrolle Aktuell September 2026
18. Informationstag Exportkontrolle – Anmeldestart
items.teaser: Anmeldungen für den 18. Informationstag Exportkontrolle sind ab sofort möglich.

items.title: 18. Informationstag Exportkontrolle – Hinweis zum Anmeldestart
items.teaser: Anmeldungen sind ab 16. September 2026 möglich.

items.title: Erinnerung: Evaluation der EU-Dual-Use-VO bis 11. September 2026
items.teaser: Vor einigen Wochen haben wir bereits per Newsletter über den Start der Umfragen zur Evaluation der EU-Dual-Use-Verordnung informiert. Da der Start der Umfragen ausgerechnet in die Ferienzeit fiel, möchten wir Sie hiermit erneut an die Umfragen erinnern.

items.title: Förderkompass 2026
items.teaser: Schnell zur passenden Förderung – erstmals ausschließlich digital verfügbar.

items.title: Exportkontrolle Aktuell Juli 2026
Evaluation der EU-Dual-Use-VO
items.teaser: Wie in den vergangenen Monaten bereits angekündigt, hat die EU-Kommission den in Art. 26 Abs. 4 der Verordnung (EU) 2021/821 (EU-Dual-Use-VO) vorgesehenen Prozess zur Evaluation gestartet.

items.title: Vorankündigung des 18. Informationstags Exportkontrolle
items.teaser: Der Informationstag Exportkontrolle (ITE) wird am 10. Dezember 2026 in Frankfurt am Main stattfinden.

items.title: 20. Exportkontrolltag in Berlin eröffnet
items.teaser: Der 20. Exportkontrolltag ist heute in Berlin eröffnet worden. Unter dem Leitthema „Exportkontrolle in der Balance?“ diskutieren heute und morgen Vertreterinnen und Vertreter aus Politik, Verwaltung, Wirtschaft, Wissenschaft und internationalen Partnerorganisationen aktuelle Entwicklungen der Exportkontrolle.

items.teaser: Hinweise zum Anmeldestart

items.title: Ausfuhrkontrolle: Bundesregierung vereinfacht Ausfuhr von bestimmten Rüstungsgütern an die Golfstaaten und die Ukraine
items.teaser: Die befristete Allgemeine Genehmigung für die Lieferung von Gütern der Luft- und maritimen Verteidigung ist zum 20. März 2026 in Kraft getreten.

items.title: Anpassung der Muster zu Endverbleibserklärungen für Ausfuhren nach Russland
items.teaser: Die Muster zu Endverbleibserklärungen für unmittelbare und mittelbare Ausfuhren nach Russland (Anlagen C 6 und C 7) wurden aktualisiert und sind ab sofort auf der BAFA-Internetseite abrufbar.

items.title: Smoke seen in Russian city of Krasnodar after drone attack and explosions – photos
items.teaser: Drones attacked Krasnodar overnight, causing multiple explosions and smoke near a National Guard compound; the city administration said the attack was repelled.

items.title: UK to produce 'middle strike,' long-range drones for Ukraine in Britain
items.teaser: Kyiv and London finalized an agreement on Nov. 21 that will see the United Kingdom manufacture "middle strike" and long-range drones for Ukraine on British soil, Ukraine's Defense Ministry announced.

items.title: Russian drone strikes private business in Poltava Oblast
items.teaser: A Russian drone struck the premises of a private business in Poltava Oblast on the night of 21-22 November.

items.title: SSU's Alpha special forces take out over 4,300 Russian troops in one week
items.teaser: Special forces of the Alpha Special Operations Center of the Security Service of Ukraine (SSU) neutralized 4,333 Russian troops in one week.

items.title: Lithuania did not allow its airspace to be used for strikes on targets in Russia, Foreign Ministry says
items.teaser: Lithuanian Foreign Minister Kęstutis Budrys has rejected claims of involvement in a drone attack on Russia's Kaliningrad Oblast, saying Lithuania never authorised use of its airspace for strikes.

items.title: Moldova, Finland report Russian airspace violations day after suspected Russian missiles flew into Poland
items.teaser: Both Moldova and Finland reported separate instances of airspace violations by Russia on Nov. 21, officials said, just one day after two suspected Russian missiles and a jet-powered drone fell on Polish territory.

items.title: Finland seeking over €25 bln in compensation from Russia and Gazprom
items.teaser: Finland is seeking to recover more than €25 billion from Russia and its state-owned gas producer Gazprom.

items.title: Poll shows 65% of Russians blame US and NATO for deaths and ruin in Ukraine, and only 6% their own country
items.teaser: Pride is the feeling Russians most often say the war in Ukraine stirs in them.

items.title: Trump posts photo of himself with Putin captioned "my friend"
items.teaser: The US president posted a series of photos from meetings with the Russian and Chinese leaders, describing Putin as "my friend" in one caption.

items.title: Russo-Ukrainian war, day 1732: Residents report explosions and drone activity at Russia’s Baltic Fleet base in Kaliningrad
items.teaser: Poland disclosed why it did not shoot down a Russian cruise missile despite NATO’s green light for a Swedish pilot, UNICEF reported a record toll of Ukrainian children killed or injured in 2026, and Zelenskyy answered the Trump-Putin-Xi meeting in China by saying big powers can’t decide the whole world’s fate.

items.title: Backed by 43 of 70 states, Ukrainian female expert joins Geneva Conventions’ fact-finding commission for first time in its 35-year history
items.teaser: Nataliia Hendel won a five-year seat on the International Humanitarian Fact-Finding Commission in a 20 November vote in Bern.

items.title: Explosions reported at Russia’s Baltic Fleet base in Kaliningrad, a strategic exclave between NATO states
items.teaser: Residents reported explosions and drone activity in Baltiysk, where Russia's Baltic Fleet is based. Any confirmed Ukrainian drone strike there would reach a major Russian military facility surrounded by NATO territory.

items.title: State Special Transport Service deminers clear over 230,000 hectares of liberated territory
items.teaser: Demining teams from the State Special Transport Service (SSTS) of Ukraine’s Ministry of Defense have surveyed and cleared more than 230,000 hectares of territory liberated from Russian forces.

items.title: Poland discloses why it didn’t shoot down Russian cruise missile, even though Swedish pilot had NATO’s green light
items.teaser: Poland tracked 11 objects, three of which crossed its border.

items.title: Howerla: Urlaub vom Krieg auf dem höchsten Berg der Ukraine
items.teaser: Auf dem Gipfel des Hoverla in der Ukraine ist es ruhig. Viele Ukrainer besteigen den Berg um zur Ruhe zu kommen, um dem Krieg der ihre Heimat mehr als nur körperlich zu entkommen.

items.title: Swedish Gripen pilot unable to shoot down suspected Russian missile over Poland due to poor weather, commander says
items.teaser: The aircraft were participating in a two-month NATO air defense deployment to protect Polish airspace. Although primarily based in Sweden, the fighters could operate from a forward air base in Poland, according to the Swedish Armed Forces.

items.title: “Big bosses” can’t decide world’s fate, Zelenskyy says, after Trump, Putin and Xi meet in China
items.teaser: Big powers always think they can decide the fate of the whole world, he said.

items.title: Denmark seeks EU-wide visa ban for Russian tourists after alleged Kremlin assassination plot on Ukrainian-American rapper
items.teaser: Copenhagen is pushing for tougher travel restrictions on Russian citizens after Danish intelligence linked a foiled assassination plot against Ukrainian-American rapper Kyivstoner to Russian intelligence services.

items.title: Jet-powered drone violates Moldovan airspace twice
items.teaser: A jet-powered drone violated Moldova’s airspace twice on Saturday morning, November 21, amid Russian attacks on Ukraine.

items.title: 20. Exportkontrolltag – Save The Date
items.teaser: Der 20. Exportkontrolltag findet im Juni in Berlin statt.

items.title: Three people injured in Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia, including two children
items.teaser: The number of people injured in the Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia has risen to three, including two children.

items.title: War update: 116 clashes on front line, Russian forces pressing hardest in Pokrovsk, Kostiantynivka sectors
items.teaser: A total of 116 combat engagements took place along the front line, with Russian forces launching nearly 25 assaults on Ukrainian positions in the Pokrovsk and Kostiantynivka sectors.

items.title: Injury toll in Russian attack on Kryvyi Rih rises to 73, including nine children
items.teaser: The number of people injured in yesterday’s Russian attack on Kryvyi Rih has risen to 73, including nine children.

items.title: Ukraine, UK agree to jointly produce Ukrainian middle- and deep-strike drones in Britain
items.teaser: Ukrainian Defense Minister Yevhenii Khmara and UK Secretary of State for Defence Wes Streeting have signed project agreements on the joint production of Ukrainian middle-strike and deep-strike drones.

items.title: Explosions heard in Zaporizhzhia, traffic completely halted on bridges and DniproHES dam
items.teaser: A series of explosions was heard in Zaporizhzhia, and all traffic across the bridges and the DniproHES dam has been completely suspended.

items.title: Russisches Militär greift Bahnhof in Region Schytomyr an, es gibt einen Verletzten
items.teaser: Russische Truppen haben einen Bahnhof in der Gemeinde Owrutsch in der Oblast Schytomyr angegriffen. Eine Zivilperson wurde verletzt.

items.title: Air-raid warning issued in Russia's Kaliningrad Oblast, social media reports mention air defence activity – videos
items.teaser: Telegram channels report explosions and Russian air defence activity in Baltiysk, home to the Baltic Fleet's naval base, despite officials saying there is no threat.

items.title: Airport in Russia’s Kaliningrad region temporarily closed amid drone threat – social media
items.teaser: Khrabrovo Airport in Russia’s Kaliningrad temporarily suspended arrivals and departures.

items.title: Explosions reported near Russian Baltic Fleet base in Kaliningrad Oblast amid drone alerts
items.teaser: Ukrainian monitoring channel WarTranslated, citing Russian accounts, reported claims that drones were attacking the Baltic Fleet base in Baltiysk. The channel also relayed unverified suggestions that the drones may have been launched from a vessel.

items.title: Ukrainian mid- and long-range strike drones to be produced in UK
items.teaser: Ukraine and the UK have signed agreements on the production of Ukrainian middle- and deep-strike drones in Britain with UK funding to supply Ukraine's defence forces.

items.title: Prague pays tribute to Ukrainians who died for freedom
items.teaser: Members of the Ukrainian community and diplomats in Prague paid tribute to fellow Ukrainians who gave their lives for the freedom and future of Ukraine.

items.title: „Moralische Katastrophe“: Mehrheit der Russen sieht bei ihrem Land keine Verantwortung für Zerstörung der Ukraine
items.teaser: Eine überwiegende Mehrheit der Russen meint, ihr Land sei weder für die Zerstörungen in der Ukraine, noch dafür, dass die Bewohner großer Städte infolge russischer Luftangruffe täglich durchschnittlich 6 bis 12 Stunden ohne Strom oder Wasser auskommen müssen, verantwortlich.

items.title: Russian forces launch nearly 30 attacks on Dnipropetrovsk region, injuring five
items.teaser: Russian forces launched nearly 30 attacks on six districts of the Dnipropetrovsk region, injuring five civilians.

items.title: Kiew: Schwieriger Alltag nach russischem Beschuss
items.teaser: Russische Angriffe haben in Kiew mehrere Brücken über den Dnipro beschädigt. Das macht den Alltag im Krieg noch schwieriger als ohnehin schon.

items.title: Finland suspects Russian helicopter of violating its airspace
items.teaser: Finland suspects that a Russian helicopter violated its airspace on Saturday afternoon.

items.title: Russian military-linked cargo ship could sink after drone strike in Gulf of Finland, Finnish official warns
items.teaser: Vladyslav Vlasiuk, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky's sanctions policy adviser, commented on the incident in remarks to the Kyiv Independent. “Yes, quite a coincidence, isn’t it? items.title: Trump threatens huge penalty for companies building data centres abroad
items.teaser: US President Donald Trump has threatened to impose a huge penalty on companies that build data centres outside the United States, as the White House seeks to maintain the country's technological edge over its rivals in the artificial intelligence sector.

items.title: Selenskyj: bislang wurden der Ukraine offiziell keine "Artikel 5-ähnliche" Sicherheitsgarantien angeboten
items.teaser: Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj erklärte, dass der Ukraine bislang offiziell keine "Artikel 5-ähnliche" Sicherheitsgarantien angeboten wurden.

items.title: Ukraine's National Guard destroys US$15m Russian Pantsir air defence system with bomber drone – video
items.teaser: Lasar's Group, part of Ukraine's National Guard, has destroyed a US$15 million Russian Pantsir-S1 air defence system near occupied Donetsk using a heavy bomber drone.

items.title: Electricity supply situation remains difficult in Odesa region – Ministry of Energy
items.teaser: Following Russia's massive overnight attack on November 20, energy workers have managed to partially stabilise electricity supplies in the affected regions, but the situation remains difficult in the Odesa region.

items.title: Eleven injured in Russian attacks on Dnipropetrovsk and Kherson oblasts
items.teaser: Russian drone, artillery and air strikes injured 11 people in Dnipropetrovsk and Kherson oblasts on 21 November, with several people taken to hospital.

items.title: Russian forces strike railway station in Zhytomyr region, one injured
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked a railway station in the Ovruch community of Zhytomyr region, injuring one civilian.

items.title: Verteidigungsminister: Russen brauchen mehrere Monate, um das beschädigte Teil der Krim -Brücke vom Meeresboden zu holen
items.teaser: Der Verteidigungsminister der Ukraine Jewhenij Chmara erklärte, dass die Russen mehrere Monate benötigen würden, um das beschädigte Teil der Krim-Brücke vom Meeresboden zu holen.

items.title: It will take Russians months to raise damaged section of Crimean Bridge – Ukraine's defence minister
items.teaser: Ukrainian Defence Minister Yevhenii Khmara said it will take Russia several months to lift and tow away the damaged section of the Crimean Bridge, which is now being inspected by divers.

items.title: Khmara prepares for international meetings in Europe in coming days – Zelensky
items.teaser: Ukraine's Minister of Defence, Yevhenii Khmara, is preparing for a series of international meetings in Europe over the coming days.

items.title: Denmark calls for EU-wide travel restrictions on Russians following foiled assassination plot
items.teaser: In a diplomatic note circulated to EU governments on Nov. 20 and seen by Reuters, Denmark proposed suspending tourist visas for Russian nationals and ending recognition of Russian non-biometric passports throughout the Schengen Area.

items.title: Is Europe finally ready to play hardball with Putin?
items.teaser: Putting the issue of "European security architecture" on the negotiating table — especially as Europeans themselves are not at said table — only proves the point Ukraine has been trying to make for almost five years of full-scale invasion: if you don't stop Putin in Ukraine, he will go for Europe.

items.title: One person injured in Russian attack on railway station in Zhytomyr Oblast
items.teaser: One person was injured and taken to hospital after Russian forces attacked a railway station in the Ovruch hromada in Zhytomyr Oblast, sparking a fire.

items.title: Russian forces attack Odesa region, civilian infrastructure damaged
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked the Odesa region, damaging civilian infrastructure.

items.title: Finland confirms Ukraine attacked ship linked to Russian military
items.teaser: Finland has confirmed that Ukrainian drones hit the Russian ship Sparta II, which drifted into Finnish waters, and suspects a Russian helicopter violated its airspace.

items.title: Kontrolle des Verfassungsschutzes - "3:1 für Putin": Grünenpolitiker von Notz kritisiert Wahl von AfD und BSW ins Parlamentarische Kontrollgremium in Sachsen-Anhalt
items.teaser: Der Grünenpolitiker von Notz hat die Wahl von Abgeordneten der AfD und des BSW in das Parlamentarische Kontrollgremium des Landtags von Sachsen-Anhalt kritisiert. Von Notz sagte dem WDR, bei beiden Parteien stehe die Loyalität zur Bundesrepublik in ihrer bestehenden Form zumindest in Frage.

items.title: Zelenskyy explains how European countries will take part in talks with US and Russia
items.teaser: Zelenskyy said EU states will help prepare for Ukraine-US-Russia talks, with eight European representatives – the E5, EU institutions and NATO – attending.

items.title: Strikes on Kerch Bridge can force Kremlin to reconsider its position on negotiations – Ukraine at OSCE
items.teaser: The consequences of Russia's rejection of Ukraine's proposals for a ceasefire are now visible on the Kerch Bridge. Damage to the bridge could serve as a powerful reminder to the Kremlin of the need to reconsider its position and move towards constructive peace negotiations.

items.title: Russischer Frachter brennt im finnischen Meerbusen nach Drohnenangriff
items.teaser: Im finnischen Meerbusen ist am Samstagmorgen ein russisches Frachter nach einem Drohnangriff in Brand geraten, wie das Nachrichtenportal Yle berichet.

items.title: EU ambassador says Russia’s frozen assets will stay off the table while the bloc negotiates its next long-term budget
items.teaser: Katarína Mathernová told a Kyiv conference that adding the assets to the 2028-2034 budget talks "would make the discussion impossible," on the day the European Commission proposed another €45bn loan for Ukraine instead.

items.title: UK defence secretary visits Kyiv and discusses strengthening Ukraine's air defence with Zelenskyy
items.teaser: UK Defence Secretary Wes Streeting visited Kyiv and discussed Ukraine's air defence, anti-ballistic missiles, joint production and British aid with Zelenskyy.

items.title: Russian cargo ship catches fire in Gulf of Finland following drone attack
items.teaser: A Russian vessel caught fire in the Gulf of Finland on the morning of Saturday, November 21, after being attacked by drones.

items.title: Russia strikes Zelenskyy's hometown, killing 2
items.teaser: The attacks follow Russian President Vladimir Putin's vow of a "painful" response to Ukraine's attacks this week on the Kerch Bridge, linking Russian-occupied Crimea.

items.title: Russia attacked Ukrainian bridges 109 times before our strike on Crimean Bridge – Zelenskyy
items.teaser: Zelenskyy said Russia attacked Ukrainian bridges 109 times before the Crimean Bridge strike, calling it a logistics route to militarise occupied Crimea.

items.title: Selenskyj zu Trump-Äußerung: "Für uns ist Putin ein Feind und Mörder"
items.teaser: Bei einem Treffen im chinesischen Shenzhen hatte US-Präsident Trump am Donnerstag seinen russischen Amtskollegen Putin als "Freund" begrüßt. Der ukrainische Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj kommentierte Trumps Äußerung mit den Worten: "Für uns ist Putin ein Feind und Mörder"

items.title: Russia drone crashes on grounds of industrial enterprise in Poltava region
items.teaser: An enemy unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) crashed on the grounds of an industrial enterprise in the Kremenchuk district of Poltava region.

items.title: Next round of peace talks depends on US, Zelensky says
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky said that holding the next meeting of negotiating teams in the Ukraine-Europe-Russia-US format depends on the American side.

items.title: Did the Court Change its Approach to Defining or Proving Genocidal Intent in Gambia v. Myanmar and Did it Get it Right? Part II
items.teaser: In the first part of this post, I looked at explicit efforts within the Court in GvM to change its approach when compared to its Bosnia and Croatia cases. items.title: Ukraine needs long-term security guarantees, not just during Trump's presidency – Zelenskyy
items.teaser: Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Ukraine needs security guarantees for decades, not just for Trump's term, adding Kyiv has seen no NATO Article 5-style steps on paper.

items.title: Finland also reports drone strike on Russian vessel in Gulf of Finland
items.teaser: Finland reported a drone strike that damaged a Russian merchant vessel in the Gulf of Finland, prompting temporary airspace and maritime restrictions.

items.title: Russia moves troubled Sarmat nuclear missile toward deployment despite repeated test failures, IISS analyzes
items.teaser: Satellite imagery suggests Russia may be preparing its Sarmat intercontinental ballistic missile for combat duty, even as years of delays and failed tests raise questions about its reliability, IISS says.

items.title: Russian drone strikes private enterprise in Poltava region
items.teaser: A Russian drone struck the premises of a private enterprise in the Poltava region.

items.title: Zelensky says Ukraine has yet to see written commitments on NATO-style security guarantees
items.teaser: Responding to a question from the Kyiv Independent, Zelensky said Ukraine still needed clarity on what exactly the proposed "Article 5-like" commitments would entail.

items.title: Generalstab: fast 45.000 russische Invasoren seit Anfang November außer Gefecht gesetzt
items.teaser: In den ersten 20 Tagen des November haben die Verteidigungskräfte der Ukraine fast 45.000 russische Invasoren kampfunfähig gemacht, teilt der Chef des Generalstabs, Generalmajor Ihor Skybjuk, auf Facebook mit.

items.title: Zelenskyy says Ukraine's NATO membership remains under discussion and would benefit both
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy said Ukraine’s NATO membership is being discussed with France and the US as the clearest security guarantee.

items.title: Zelensky says Ukraine not yet received official security guarantees equivalent to NATO article 5
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky said that Ukraine has not yet officially been offered security guarantees equivalent to Article 5 of NATO, which provides for a collective response to aggression.

items.title: New Swedish interceptor takes aim at Russia’s jet-powered Geran drones as Ukraine prepares battlefield testing
items.teaser: The K200 is designed to engage faster attack drones that pose a growing challenge for Ukrainian air defenses. Its developer says the system has hit nine out of 10 targets in testing.

items.title: Zelenskyy names six candidates for Ukraine's US ambassador post
items.teaser: Zelenskyy names six candidates for Ukraine’s ambassador to the US, including Markarova, Kuleba, Sybiha and an experienced English-speaking military officer, as the position has remained vacant since Olha Stefanishyna's dismissal in August.

items.title: Selenskyj: Russen greifen Bahnstation in Region Sumy an
items.teaser: Russische Truppen haben am Samstag, den 21. November, eine Eisenbahnstation in der Region Sumy angegriffen, schreibt der ukrainische Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj auf Facebook.

items.title: Russian drone strikes residential area in Poltava region
items.teaser: An enemy drone strike has been recorded in the Lubny district of the Poltava region.

items.title: Zelenskyy ready to meet Putin at G20 if possible
items.teaser: US partners are proposing a trilateral meeting between Ukraine, Russia and the United States before Christmas.

items.title: Zelensky: Ukraine’s NATO membership being discussed
items.teaser: President of Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky has said that Ukraine’s membership in NATO would be the best security guarantee for the country.

items.title: AfD erhält zwei Sitze im Geheimdienst-Kontrollgremium
items.teaser: Der Landtag Sachsen-Anhalts wählt Tobias Rausch und Matthias Büttner in das Kontrollgremium für den Verfassungsschutz. Die AfD erhält zwei von vier Sitzen.

items.title: European Council president unveils proposal for reduced EU budget, retaining €100 billion for Ukraine
items.teaser: European Council President António Costa presented his own proposal for the European Union's multiannual budget for 2028-2034 on Saturday 21 November. items.title: Präsident und First Lady gedenken der Helden der Himmlischen Hundert an neu gestalteter Gedenkstätte
items.teaser: Am Tag der Würde und der Freiheit haben Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj und First Lady Olena Selenska das Andenken der Ukrainer gewürdigt, die während der Revolution der Würde umgekommen sind.

items.title: Streeting urges allies to go further in supporting Ukraine through winter
items.teaser: Ukraine’s allies should provide more winter assistance than they have already announced. The United Kingdom is ready to discuss additional support with Ukraine to help it get through the winter.

items.title: Zelenskyy names 15 settlements for evacuations similar to Oleshky operation
items.teaser: Zelenskyy has named 15 settlements in Russian-occupied Kherson and Zaporizhzhia oblasts where Ukraine proposes humanitarian evacuations similar to the Oleshky operation.

items.title: Zelensky: Russia attacked Ukrainian bridges 109 times before Ukraine struck Kerch Bridge
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky said Russia had carried out 109 attacks on Ukrainian bridges before Ukraine launched a retaliatory operation against the Kerch Bridge.
